title: Enhance UI design and visual polish

requirements.summary: Redesign overall UI with improved visual hierarchy, spacing, and typography for a polished modern appearance
acceptanceCriteria: Improved spacing and padding throughout the application for better visual breathing room
Enhanced typography hierarchy with clear differentiation between headings, body text, and labels
Consistent visual design language applied across all pages and components
Professional and polished appearance that elevates the current design

file_operations.description: Enhance the global typography system with refined font sizes, line heights, and letter spacing. Improve the color palette with more sophisticated shades and tints. Add utility classes for consistent spacing scales and refined shadow definitions for visual depth.

Extend the Tailwind theme with refined color scales, enhanced spacing values, improved typography scale with custom font sizes and weights, and sophisticated shadow definitions for elevation hierarchy.

requirements.summary: Enhance report request form with improved visual design, field layouts, and validation feedback
acceptanceCriteria: Form fields have improved visual styling with clear focus states
Better visual distinction between required and optional fields
Enhanced error message presentation with improved color and placement
Success alerts are more visually prominent and well-designed

file_operations.description: Refine the form's visual design with improved spacing between fields, enhanced input styling with better borders and focus states, refined label typography with clear required field indicators, polished error message presentation with improved colors and positioning, and more prominent success alert styling with better visual hierarchy.

requirements.summary: Improve dashboard table design with enhanced styling, hover states, and status badges
acceptanceCriteria: Table has improved visual styling with better borders and spacing
Row hover states are more prominent and polished
Status badges have enhanced visual design with better color coding
Column headers are visually distinct and easier to scan

file_operations.description: Enhance the table's visual design with refined borders and cell spacing, improved row hover effects with subtle background color transitions, redesigned status badges with better color coding and rounded styling, enhanced column header typography and visual distinction, and better overall visual hierarchy for improved scannability.

requirements.summary: Enhance navigation and header design with improved tab styling and role toggle presentation
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation tabs have improved visual design with clearer active states
Header layout is more polished with better spacing and alignment
Role toggle component has enhanced visual presentation
Overall header feels more premium and professional

file_operations.description: Refine the header layout with improved spacing and alignment, enhance navigation tab styling with clearer active states using refined borders or backgrounds, improve the overall header visual hierarchy with better typography and element positioning for a more premium feel.

Enhance the role toggle component with refined visual styling including improved button design, better badge presentation with enhanced colors and spacing, and more polished icon integration for a premium appearance.

requirements.summary: Refine modal design with improved styling, content organization, and interactive elements
acceptanceCriteria: Modal has improved visual design with better shadows and borders
Content sections within the modal are better organized with clear visual separation
Review controls have enhanced styling with clearer call-to-action buttons
Modal overlay and transitions feel more polished

file_operations.description: Enhance the modal's visual design with refined shadows and borders for better depth, improve content section organization with clearer visual separators and spacing, refine review control styling with more prominent call-to-action buttons using enhanced colors and hover states, and improve the modal overlay with better opacity and subtle transitions.

requirements.summary: Apply cohesive visual theme with sophisticated color palette, shadows, and consistent interactive styling
acceptanceCriteria: A refined color palette is consistently applied throughout the application
Shadows and elevation are used strategically to create visual depth
All buttons, inputs, and interactive elements share consistent styling patterns
The overall visual theme feels cohesive and premium across all pages

file_operations.description: Apply the refined visual theme to the submit request page with improved layout spacing, enhanced heading typography, and better visual hierarchy for instructional content to create a cohesive premium experience.

Apply the refined visual theme to the view requests page with improved layout spacing, enhanced heading typography, and better visual hierarchy for page content to maintain visual consistency across the application.

Apply the refined visual theme to the admin dashboard page with improved layout spacing, enhanced heading typography, and better visual hierarchy for instructional content to ensure cohesive styling across all administrative views.
